intro: Speak with Renferrel is a brief errand within the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. High Executor Hadrec directs you back to the Royal Apothecary Society's local researcher to discuss findings regarding tainted wolf hearts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons. He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
